title: A positioned mark at a box's start lands inside the box, over its label
foundBy: repository owner, reading a consuming page at the one-hour zoom: "the opening one ... gets swallowed up"
details:
A positioned mark begins at its position and extends right. A consuming page draws each dispatch as a box from its opening to its reply. The opening and the reply are marks on the row the box's label sits in. The reply mark begins where the box ends, so it sits just outside. The opening mark begins where the box begins, so it sits just inside, on top of the label, and reads as swallowed.

A mark should be able to end at its position instead, so an opening sits just before its box as a reply sits just after.
